dct_title_s: Philippines Typhoon Fung-Wong: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Typhoon Fung-Wong: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Philippines Typhoon Fung-Wong (Nov 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Eastern Luzon, Philippines, Typhoon Fung-Wong, 11 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Eastern Luzon, Philippines, Typhoon Fung-Wong, 11 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Bicol and Eastern Visayas, Philippines, Typhoon Fung-Wong, 10 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Bicol Region, Philippines, Typhoon Fung-Wong, 09 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Bicol Region, Philippines, Typhoon Fung-Wong, 09 Nov 2025, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
